checks.detail: Fail. Same-session Tester input crossed the MAP01 bridge to the training stones and returned, but source and live play expose only one map. The opening, Isa request, teaching, combat, lamp, upgrade, pause, save, and reload sequence is absent. Escape releases the cursor without pausing. Walking beside the bridge causes an unrecoverable fall. The visible HUD is a default text label. The adjacent R04 boundary check found an unarmed start; no later R04 outcome was inferred. The off-bridge path was the risk-weighted undocumented surface explored; unrelated keys lacked owning systems and were lower priority. A completed, unpaused physical W sequence additionally changed player z from 4.0 to -7.94 and captured three distinct 1280×720 frames at 114, 1302, and 2511 ms. The Host must bind the retained Tester trace for these live observations. coverage.baseline.adjacent_continuity.1fa5438163b4=pass; coverage.baseline.exploratory_review.0914e49a767e=fail;

Fail. Same-session Tester input confirmed WASD, mouse look, Tab shoulder switching, and a Space jump. A completed, unpaused physical W sequence changed position and velocity and captured three distinct early, middle, and late frames. The jump rose from y≈0.95 to y≈2.28 and landed, but retained rigid limbs with only a whole-body pitch. Shift did not provide sprint speed; Alt and B produced no dodge or roll response. Source has no automatic step traversal or locomotion animation path. At the south wall both shoulder views lose the player entirely. Physical-only InputMap bindings were probed with physical key events; no duplicate custom bindings were found. The Host must bind the retained Tester trace for the live observations. coverage.validation.runtime.8581df546013=fail; coverage.validation.visual.fb0eb54ed527=fail; coverage.baseline.input_binding_integrity.755c1e4f1c7d=fail; coverage.baseline.exploratory_review.9b31eaeb0ff2=fail;

required_criteria.requirement:
Review the declared production milestone 基础空间与可玩切片。: **基础空间与可玩切片。** 核查三张地图的通路与战场容量，完成移动、镜头和基础性能；制作一段约 5–8 分钟的短演出交还控制、伊莎求助、NPC 交剑弓示范、训练与实战、灯术/首次升级、暂停存档和重载体验；先验证演出与可玩系统衔接，具体节奏由试玩调整。
Require candidate-bound runtime evidence for this milestone; future milestones remain pending, and previously verified behavior must be preserved. This milestone review does not waive any final PRD requirement.

PRD R02: 移动、跳跃、冲刺、闪避、自动上阶与镜头有效；朝向、手持、背挂和切肩正确
Bind candidate runtime evidence to scenario(s): review_r02. This is a required product acceptance review, not an executable test or a passed observation.

developer_outcome.summary: The final candidate completed an ordinary-input trip to the landmark and back and a physical Space takeoff and landing. Candidate-bound motion, frames, floor transition, and clean runtime logs were observed. Wall and face visual issues remain open.

risk_note.summary: A visible route or input binding may still lack evidence of a completed player journey.
risk_note.validation: Replay physical movement to the landmark and back, then Space through takeoff and landing; capture runtime state, logs, and shipped-camera frames, including the known wall and face views.
risk_note.why_now: The prior review observed only an enclosure and measured Space as producing no jump.

task_requirements.requirement: From a fresh start, ordinary movement reaches a recognizable river-village route from its safe starting area to a bridge or training landmark and back, with solid route collision and candidate-bound frames at the start, landmark, boundary, and return.

A physical Space press on that route produces one visible jump takeoff, airborne displacement, and landing with a matching player pose; before-and-after position, velocity, floor state, and shipped-camera frames support the observation.
